trainingAttendees/{attendeeId}._note: One person from an SME. The director's doc id is {enrollmentId}_director. Types: src/components/trainings/trainingStorage.ts TrainingAttendee
trainingAttendees/{attendeeId}.attends: boolean  (employees always true; a director is often only the owner)
trainingAttendees/{attendeeId}.name: string
trainingAttendees/{attendeeId}.email: string  (required: their login and QR self check-in)
trainingAttendees/{attendeeId}.eligibilityOverride: { by, byName, reason, at } | null  (staff only)

trainingCompanyProgress/{enrollmentId}._note: Totals only (no names), Cloud Function only. Read by staff and everyone in the company. Type: TrainingCompanyProgress in src/components/trainings/certification.ts

trainingCertificates/{certificateId}._note: Staff create drafts and send them for signature; signatures, number, PDF and issue/revoke are written by Cloud Functions only. Type: TrainingCertificate
trainingCertificates/{certificateId}.data: map<string,string>  (values filled into the PDF form fields)
trainingCertificates/{certificateId}.signatures: map<signatoryKey, { uid, name, title, signatureURL, signedAt, userAgent }>
trainingCertificates/{certificateId}.verificationCode: string  (HMAC, printed and in the QR)

certificateTemplates/{templateId}._note: Fillable PDF; form-field names are the placeholders. Training Academy staff manage. Type: CertificateTemplate
certificateTemplates/{templateId}.name: string

trainingSettings/certification._note: Global certification defaults; trainings.certification overrides field by field. Type: CertificationSettings
trainingSettings/certification.signatories: CertificateSignatory[]  (default: Academy head by department role 'training')

trainings/{trainingId} (new fields).plan[].category: string | null  (one of categories; null = everyone)

appointments/{id} (new fields, Training.attendeeId: string | null  (trainingAttendees id; smeId stays the enrollment id)

users/{uid} (new fields, role training_s.participantId: trainingEnrollments id (unchanged; the company, for directors and employees)
